subject.title: feat(ui): five-zone sidebar — agent identity card, threads/groups/coding, footer bar

question: Should the owner-directed five-zone sidebar become the default Control UI hierarchy, including collapsing Coding for users who have never stored a sidebar-collapse preference?
rationale: This is a deliberate product-hierarchy and first-run/default change, not a mechanically derivable bug fix; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human judgment.

options.title: Approve the five-zone default
options.body: Accept the new agent-first hierarchy and Coding-first-run collapse after real UI proof confirms the intended fresh and upgrade-adjacent behavior.

options.title: Preserve the former initial expansion
options.body: Keep Coding expanded when no preference exists if the product owner does not want unchanged installations to receive the new collapsed default.

recommendation.title: Approve the five-zone default
recommendation.body: Accept the new agent-first hierarchy and Coding-first-run collapse after real UI proof confirms the intended fresh and upgrade-adjacent behavior.
